summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Watchlist not persisting across login (do not implement yet)  **What I found by reading the code (no changes made):**  The backend scoping logic itself looks solid — `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` filters every read/write by `user_id` derived from the session, and `modules/watchlist/schema.ts` makes `user_id` `NOT NULL`. There's no anonymous/guest fallback and no localStorage caching of watchlist data on the client. So this is not a "missing feature" — it's a narrower bug, most likely one of:  1. **Cookie `secure` flag mismatch (highest suspicion).** `modules/auth/
